text: In 2.1.17 the M33 page's 'Przypadki brzegowe' section (m33edge0) switched from <tagged_list type="ac" tags="m33"/> to tags="m33-edge", and the 'Kryteria akceptacji' section (m33ac001) lists tags="m33". But at 2.1.17 none of the 21 edge-case criteria this unit names carries the tag `m33-edge` — all still carry only `m33` (one also `m13-edge`), and their before == after in the window. So at the release the edge-case section renders empty and the edge cases still appear in the acceptance-criteria list: the regrouping the unit's goal describes did not happen in the entities. Assumed: the 21 criteria (kind edge-case, named by the recipe) are the intended content of m33edge0; they are verified as-is and no code depends on their tags. Needed in the spec: add `m33-edge` to these criteria (and drop `m33` if the AC section should not repeat them).
